name: David Abels
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Chicago, Illinois
about: David Abels is a partner at the law firm of Abels & Annes, P.C. with offices in both Chicago, Illinois and Phoenix, Arizona. Dave has focused his practice on helping personal injury victims since 1997. He handles a variety of personal injury cases, such as auto accidents , bicycle and pedestrian accidents, truck crashes, premises liability, workers' compensation and sex abuse claims.

Dave works hard to accomplish his goal of making every client happy, with both a high level of personal service and strong results. He has had great success in working towards that goal, and backs it up with a significant list of client testimonials on his website: http://www.daveabels.com/testimonials.html

His office understands that being injured in an accident is a very difficult experience, which is why they have lawyers on call 24/7 to talk to new potential clients and answer their questions. The law firm can be reached toll-free at (855) LAW-CHICAGO.

Dave was born and raised in Evanston, Illinois where he attended and graduated from Evanston Township High School (class of 1987). He then went on to college at the University of Wisconsin, Madison and graduated in 1991. Finally he attended the John Marshall Law Cchool in Chicago, and was sworn into the Illinois Bar in 1994. Several years later he was admitted into the Arizona Bar.
